title: How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance
abstract: arXiv:2611.19747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision models are sensitive to object-background context, yet it remains unclear how recognition changes as the semantic distance between objects and backgrounds increases. We introduce ImageNet-OOC1k, a benchmark enabling graded control of object-background relationships along a continuous consensus visual-semantic dissimilarity axis. This formulation reveals a highly consistent monotonic decline in recognition accuracy across 35 models spanning convolutional neural networks, Vision Transformers, and vision-language models. Internal analyses of Vision Transformers reveal patterns consistent with aggregation failure, where object evidence is present at the patch level but not consolidated into the final prediction. Using this characterization as a diagnostic probe, a simple spatial re-ranking strategy recovers a subset of these errors and improves in-sample accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points. translated_title: 多远才算太远？物体识别随语义距离的增加而单调下降
translated_abstract: 视觉模型对物体与背景之间的上下文关系十分敏感，然而随着物体与背景之间语义距离的增加，识别性能如何变化仍不清楚。我们提出了 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，该基准能够沿着连续的共识视觉-语义不相似性轴对物体-背景关系进行分级控制。这一方法揭示了在涵盖卷积神经网络、视觉Transformer和视觉-语言模型的35个模型中，识别准确率呈现高度一致的单调下降。对视觉Transformer的内部分析揭示了与“聚合失败”一致的模式，即物体证据存在于图像块级别，但未能被整合到最终预测中。利用这种表征作为诊断探针，一种简单的空间重排序策略可以挽回部分此类错误，并将样本内准确率提升高达5.7个百分点。这些结果确立了上下文敏感性……
tldr: 该论文提出 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，发现物体识别准确率随物体与背景语义距离的增加在35个模型中均单调下降，并基于“聚合失败”的诊断提出空间重排序策略，可将准确率提升高达5.7个百分点。
en_tdlr: Introducing the ImageNet-OOC1k benchmark, this paper shows that object recognition accuracy declines monotonically with increasing object-background semantic distance across 35 models, and proposes a spatial re-ranking strategy that recovers aggregation-failure errors and improves accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points.
